Work with us

Why Join Magic Software, a Matrix Company?

At Magic Software, we believe our people are the driving force behind our success. As part of the Matrix Group, one of the leading global technology services and consulting organizations, we offer opportunities to work with talented professionals worldwide, contribute to meaningful projects, and build a rewarding career in a dynamic and innovative environment.

Matrix is a global technology company with more than 17,000 employees worldwide, delivering advanced software solutions, digital transformation services, IT consulting, infrastructure solutions, outsourcing services, and technology innovation to customers across a wide range of industries. Our expertise spans Finance, Telecommunications, Healthcare, Hi-Tech, Education, Defense, Security, and the Public Sector, serving organizations across the globe.

A Global Company. A Multicultural Community.

When you join Magic Software, you become part of a company with a distinguished tradition of innovation, technology excellence, and professional achievement. We believe that every employee plays an essential role in the success and sustainability of our organization.

We are proud of our diverse, inclusive, and multicultural workforce, where people from different backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives come together to collaborate, innovate, and make an impact. Our culture encourages knowledge sharing, teamwork, continuous learning, and mutual respect.

We are committed to creating an environment where employees can develop their skills and competencies, collaborate with talented colleagues around the world, expand their professional expertise, and enjoy a meaningful and rewarding career. Whether you’re looking to deepen your technical knowledge, explore new career paths, or take on leadership opportunities, you’ll find the support and encouragement to grow.

Our Commitment to Our People

Our goal is to consistently attract, motivate, develop, and retain talented professionals by fostering a collaborative, engaging, and enriching work environment. We recognize and value each individual’s contribution and invest in helping our people achieve their full potential.

Many of our employees build long-term careers with us, growing across teams, functions, technologies, and even geographies. Internal mobility, professional development, and continuous learning are fundamental to how we help our people succeed.

We’re Always Looking for Great Talent

Even if you don’t currently see a role that matches your experience, we encourage you to connect with us.

We welcome applications from talented professionals across all disciplines, backgrounds, and locations. Every application is carefully reviewed by our Talent Acquisition team. If your experience and skills align with a current opportunity, we will reach out to discuss the next steps.

If there isn’t an immediate match, we will keep your resume within our global talent network and stay connected for future opportunities that may be relevant to your background and career interests. Great talent is always worth keeping in touch with.

What You Can Expect

  • Work with talented teams across the globe
  • Contribute to innovative and impactful projects
  • Grow your career through learning and development opportunities
  • Explore internal mobility and global career paths
  • Collaborate in a diverse, inclusive, and multicultural workplace
  • Share knowledge and learn from experienced professionals
  • Enjoy competitive compensation, benefits, and career growth opportunities

Join Us

Join Magic Software and Matrix and become part of a global team where innovation, collaboration, and people come first. Build your future with a company that values your contributions, invests in your growth, and creates opportunities for long-term career success.

Your next opportunity may start here. We look forward to getting to know you.
